The TypeScript package's recorded Stats answers, for the parity test of this
package (tests/test_stats_ts_answers.py).

These files are bca-mcp-ts test/fixtures/stats_api as of its commit 3b44014,
copied unchanged: answers/, expected_outputs/, shards/, SHA256SUMS and
README.md. 25 of the 38 calls come from the API's dump
(scripts/dump_stats_answers.py at API commit b1bbcbe, on the API's made-up
fixtures); the others are stand-ins made before the dump existed. Their
README says which is which and how the expected outputs were made: from the
design's reference rules, not from either package's code. Every address is
made up (0x plus SHA-256 of a bca-fixture string), and no address, vault
name or figure is from the real files.

This package's own set stays in tests/fixtures/stats_api.
